授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本授業のテーマは民主的な学校です。流れとしては、まず民主的な学校とはどのような学校かを理論的に説明する。その後に、文献やドキュメンタリーで報告された具体的な事例を議論する。最後に自分の教育経験を踏まえながら、どのようにアジアの学校をより民主的にするかを提言してみる。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course explores the idea of making schools a democratic place, that is, a place not merely teaching democracy but also practising democracy. It discusses some theoretical aspects of democratic schooling. By looking at experiences and lessons from schools around the world, the course invites students to share their suggestions for making schools a democratic place, particularly in Asia, while considering possible limits and challenges.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考: Readings and slides are in English, while the instructor will use both English and Japanese in class. Students are encouraged to use whichever language (English or Japanese) they feel comfortable in class.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: 50%. Students are required to submit a course essay in Week 8. In the course essay, students should, firstly, relate the theories and cases discussed in class to personal school experience, and secondly, offer their original suggestion for making Asian schools more democratic. The essay can be written in English (1000 words) or Japanese (2000 words).
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.発表: Students are required to present their course essays in Week 8.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Attendance is the prerequisite for class discussion.
